other_conditions: Minimum of 1 acre of agricultural land required for every 5 indigenous cows (land requirement increases proportionally with number of animals)
Applicable only to indigenous cows recognised by the government
Applicant (individual, NGO or registered cow shelter) must be registered with the Gau Samvardhan Board
Applicant must have a dedicated space with facilities for feeding, cleaning and medical care for the cows
Applicant must possess a valid Aadhaar card
Cow must be registered with the Gau Samvardhan Board
Applicant must have a bank account in the name of the cow shelter or in their individual name
benefits_summary: Provides up to Rs 10 lakhs per project with 75 % bank loan, margin‑money assistance, and interest reimbursement up to Rs 25,000 per annum for 7 years.
documents_required: Cow registration certificate with Gau Samvardhan Board
